text_block_list.text:
After declaring war on Tokai Teio, Nice 
Nature was venting her screams of regret 
into the hollow of a tree stump.

Overwhelmed by anxiety, Nice Nature lets 
her vulnerability show. To support her, 
the Trainer offers words of encouragement 
straight from the heart.

Realizing that her Trainer and the 
shopping district folks are cheering her 
on, she pulls herself together, deciding 
she can't just keep whining...
